title: Four little Python pieces
heading: Big programs start with little pieces.
description: Here are four building blocks you’ll meet in Python. You don’t need to remember all their names yet—we’ll play with them one at a time.

scene.label: An introduction to Python building blocks.

explanation.title: Constants: a value written in the code
explanation.text: These are fixed values: the number 3 and the text Hi! Python calls values written like this literals. The quotes tell Python which part is text.

explanation.title: Expressions: work out a value
explanation.text: Python works this out to get 5. You can give that result to the fox, too: fox.move(2 + 3).

explanation.title: Variables: give values names
explanation.text: The first line remembers Ola using a variable called username. The next line uses that value, so the fox says Ola. Change "Ola" to your name and the greeting changes!

explanation.title: Keywords: special Python words
explanation.text: These words have special jobs. Later, if will help us choose, for will help us repeat, and def will help us name a new trick. They are pieces of instructions, not programs on their own.
